classification.difficultyReason: Part a is direct ratio writing from the left triangle. Part b requires the student to notice that the same θ means the same cos ratio, 15/17, then choose adjacent/hypotenuse in the second triangle. They must set up and solve 24/x = 15/17, which is two linked steps with a representation change but no signposting of the method.

content.prompt: The two triangles have the same angle $\theta$.

children.label: a
children.prompt: For the left triangle, write $\sin\theta$, $\cos\theta$ and $\tan\theta$ as fractions.

answer.worked:
In the right triangle, $24$ is adjacent to $\theta$ and $x$ is the hypotenuse.

$\begin{aligned}\cos\theta&=\frac{A}{H}\\\cos\theta&=\frac{24}{x}\\x\cos\theta&=24\\x&=\frac{24}{\cos\theta}\\x&=24\div\frac{15}{17}\\x&=24\times\frac{17}{15}\\x&=27.2\end{aligned}$
